title: com.status arguments (fabric-project-comms/0.1, DEC-0073)
description: Estate, caller Project, principal and session come from the authenticated endpoint and are never accepted here: an unknown field is refused (invalid_arguments).

project.description: The Project to report on. A Project session's Project comes from its endpoint: it omits this or names its own Project, and another Project is not_authorized. A viewer principal (a host such as Fabric Dashboards) names the Project it was granted.
